records.question: Does Kolmogorov–Loveland randomness coincide with Martin-Löf randomness?
records.status_statement: SRC-0018's publisher abstract calls whether Martin-Löf randomness is the same as KL-randomness one of the major open problems in effective randomness.
records.later_status_note: SRC-0019's 2025 publisher abstract explicitly still calls KLR=MLR a major open problem.
records.current_status_note: SOURCE-STATED OPEN on the documented 2025 evidence. P1-S001 did not find and does not claim an exhaustive post-2025 resolution search.
